name: CMU Computer Club (includes PPP hacking team)
notes: University club at Carnegie Mellon University (Pittsburgh, US). Club's own homepage links its Discord (and IRC libera/#cmucc) via the discord icon; also home to PPP, CMU's DEF CON-winning CTF team.

name: HackBU
notes: University club at Binghamton University (Binghamton, US). General hacking/hackathon-oriented tech club (not exclusively infosec) but a common on-ramp for students interested in security/CTFs at Binghamton.

name: UD Cyber Security / Capture the Flag Club
notes: University club at University of Delaware (Newark, US). Listed on UD's CIS department student-clubs page; competes in weekly CTFs, runs sessions on crypto/exploitation/reverse engineering/forensics. Contact Landon Jones lhjones@udel.edu.

name: Cornell Hacking Club (CHC)
notes: University club at Cornell University (Ithaca, US). CTF-focused club (CTFtime team 'CHC'). Invite link surfaced via search snippet dated ~2021, not independently re-verified live on the club site (chc.cs.cornell.edu could not be fetched this session, DNS failure) — should be re-checked before publishing.

name: UF Student Infosec Team (UFSIT)
notes: University club at University of Florida (Gainesville, US). Weekly meetings Thursdays; CCDC/CTF focused.

name: Cybersecurity Club at Florida State University (H4CK3RS)
notes: University club at Florida State University (Tallahassee, US). Discord link served from club's official Linktree.

name: Cybersecurity Club at GSU
notes: University club at Georgia State University (Atlanta, US). ~1000 members on Discord per Linktree.

name: Society for Cyber Security (UGA SCS)
notes: University club at University of Georgia (Athens, US). Covers offensive/defensive security, CTFs, forensics.

name: Clemson Cyber
notes: University club at Clemson University (Clemson, US). Student-led club covering technical and social sides of security.

name: USC CybOrg
notes: University club at University of South Carolina (Columbia, US). Premier cybersecurity & digital forensics org at USC.

name: ntropy (UNC CTF Team)
notes: University club at University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (Chapel Hill, US). UNC's competitive CTF team.

name: Cyber Security Club @ Ohio State (OSU Cyber)
notes: University club at The Ohio State University (Columbus, US). Runs BuckeyeCTF; link surfaced via search of club's own domain (osucyber.club), could not directly render the JS site to confirm on-page.

name: WolvSec
notes: University club at University of Michigan (Ann Arbor, US). Computer security club and CTF team; also listed on Maize Pages (maizepages.umich.edu/organization/wolvsec). Site listed a second discord.gg/333DvQVeks link too; primary one used here.

name: Information Assurance Student Group (IASG / Hacking and Cyber Security Club)
notes: University club at Iowa State University (Ames, US). Primary out-of-meeting communication channel per club's own site.

name: ACM Security (Missouri S&T ACM cybersecurity SIG)
notes: University club at Missouri University of Science and Technology (Rolla, US). Cybersecurity special-interest group of Missouri S&T's ACM chapter.

name: Spartan Hackers
notes: University club at Michigan State University (East Lansing, US). General hacking/hackathon-and-ethical-hacking club (~1200 in Discord); MSU also has a separate, narrower 'Cybersecurity Club' that could not be located online.

name: Dakota State University Cyber/Computer Clubs (Computer Club, CTF Club, Ethical Hacking Club)
notes: University club at Dakota State University (Madison, US). Shared student-run wiki/Discord umbrella for DSU's cyber-focused clubs (CTF Club and Ethical Hacking Club co-run the year-long DSU CTF); DSU CybHER (women in cyber) is a separate club with no public link found.

name: UT Information & Systems Security Society (ISSS)
notes: University club at University of Texas at Austin (Austin, US). Student-run security club in the CS department at UT Austin.

name: Hashdump Security Club
notes: University club at Colorado State University (Fort Collins, US). General security awareness club, open to all majors.

name: ACM Cyber at UCSD
notes: University club at University of California, San Diego (La Jolla, US). 700+ member cybersecurity community, CTF training, workshops.

name: UW Cybersecurity Club
notes: University club at University of Waterloo (Waterloo, CA). Discord invite shared by a club officer in a LinkedIn post promoting the club; not confirmed live on the club's own site (ctf.uwaterloo.ca returned a connection error when fetched directly).

name: UCL Cyber Security Society
notes: University club at University College London (London, GB). Linktree lists Discord under Socials alongside WhatsApp/Instagram.

name: Imperial College Cybersecurity Society
notes: University club at Imperial College London (London, GB). Listed on the Imperial College Union CSP page for the Cybersecurity society.

name: SUCSS - Cyber Security Society (University of Southampton)
notes: University club at University of Southampton (Southampton, GB). Found via a Discord-server listing snippet ('Join the SUCSS - Cyber Security Society Discord Server!'); matches SUCSS from the ENUSEC UK CyberSec Societies directory (sucss.org).

name: DMU Hackers
notes: University club at De Montfort University (Leicester, GB). Discord link appears repeatedly on the club's own homepage.

name: ENUSEC
notes: University club at Edinburgh Napier University (Edinburgh, GB). Vanity domain that forwards to the club's Discord invite; referenced repeatedly on their own site.

name: Hack Keele - The Computing Society
notes: University club at Keele University (Keele, GB). Found via a Discord-server listing snippet; matches HackKeele from the ENUSEC UK CyberSec Societies directory. Covers general computing incl. cybersecurity.

name: Cyber Security Society RHUL
notes: University club at Royal Holloway, University of London (Egham, GB). Discord link shown on the society's own Linktree.

name: Abertay Hackers (HackSoc)
notes: University club at Abertay University (Dundee, GB). Vanity Discord-invite subdomain of the club's own site (hacksoc.co.uk), found via search snippet 'HackSoc Discord Invite'; club's main site returned 403 to automated fetch so the link could not be directly confirmed on-page.

name: Open University Cyber Security Club
notes: University club at The Open University (, GB). For students on the R60 cybersecurity degree and other pathways; distance-learning university so no physical city. Also has vanity link join.oucss.rocks.

name: ENOFLAG / AG Rechnersicherheit (TU Berlin)
notes: University club at Technische Universität Berlin (Berlin, DE). No Discord/Matrix found; they list email, Mastodon, and a Jitsi meeting room (meet.enoflag.de/erstis) as public entry points instead. Listed as guess since the Jitsi link is the closest thing to a public join link seen on their own page.

name: polygl0ts (EPFL CTF team)
notes: University club at École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (Lausanne, CH). Official EPFL CTF team; Discord link confirmed on their own contact page.

name: Radboud Institute of Pwning
notes: University club at Radboud University Nijmegen (Nijmegen, NL). Page explicitly mentions 'public meetings and Discord' as the way to join, but the exact invite URL was not visible on the fetched page.

name: Stellar Vector
notes: University club at KU Leuven (Leuven, BE). Primarily-academic CTF team associated with KU Leuven; Discord is described as their main communication channel.

name: Kalmarunionen (KalmarCTF)
notes: University club at Danish/Nordic academic CTF collective (DTU-affiliated) (, DK). Collaborative of mostly Danish/Nordic academic CTF players (DTU and others), not a single university club, but the leading Nordic academic CTF community; Discord is for the KalmarCTF event/team.

name: SCSC (Swedish Cyber Security Challenge)
notes: University club at KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Stockholm, SE). ECSC/SCSC national student qualifier hosted by KTH; Discord is for organizer communication with participating students.

name: Itemize NTNU
notes: University club at Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) (Trondheim, NO). Norwegian CTF team out of NTNU Trondheim; Discord link found in the site footer.

name: CTF Club - Chair of IT Security, BTU Cottbus-Senftenberg
notes: University club at Brandenburgische Technische Universität Cottbus-Senftenberg (Cottbus, DE). University-run CTF club; page states the club communicates mainly through Discord.

name: Cyber Security Community (CSeC), IIT Bombay
notes: University club at Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (Mumbai, IN). Also referenced as IITBreachers CTF team via csea-iitb.github.io wiki, which lists a different invite (discord.gg/eHGwP6CGSy) for what appears to be the same broader club; used the club's own current site (cseciitb.github.io) as primary.

name: Programming Club, IIT Kanpur (InfoSec vertical)
notes: University club at Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (Kanpur, IN). InfoSec is a track/team within the broader Programming Club, which runs a dedicated infosec roadmap (wiredin.pclub.in) and an infosec channel on this shared Discord; no separate infosec-only server was found.

name: The Sydney Computing Society (SYNCS)
notes: University club at University of Sydney (Sydney, AU). Infosec/security-focused computing society; Discord invite listed in site footer under social links.

name: RMIT Information Security Collective (RISC)
notes: University club at RMIT University (Melbourne, AU). Discord link found on the club's official Linktree (linked from its Instagram bio).

name: QUT Whitehats
notes: University club at Queensland University of Technology (Brisbane, AU). Discord found on club's official Linktree.

name: Deakin Information Security Club (DISC)
notes: University club at Deakin University (Melbourne, AU). Slack signup link listed alongside club website and email in their Facebook group description.

name: Otago University Cyber Security Club (OUCSS)
notes: University club at University of Otago (Dunedin, NZ). Discord invite explicitly listed on official Otago University Students' Association club page; also has short link https://join.oucss.rocks.

name: CiberSecUNI
notes: University club at Universidad Nacional de Ingeniería (UNI) (Lima, PE). Official partner of HackTheBox; organizes HTB Meetup Lima. Discord link found in the site's contact/footer section.

name: Cyber Security Club, Uttara University
notes: University club at Uttara University (Dhaka, BD). Motto "Hunt Together, Defend Together"; runs CTFs and CyberCon25. Discord link on official club site.
